rocks.name: 橄榄岩
rocks.description_en: Ultramafic intrusive rock composed mainly of olivine with pyroxene. Source of chromium, platinum, and other valuable metals.
rocks.description: 超基性侵入岩，主要由橄榄石和辉石组成。是铬、铂等金属的重要来源岩石。

rocks.name: 金伯利岩
rocks.description_en: Ultramafic volcanic rock, primary source of diamonds. Kimberlite pipe eruptions bring diamonds from mantle.
rocks.description: 含钻石的超基性火山岩。金刚石的主要来源。

rocks.name: 苦橄岩
rocks.description_en: Ultramafic volcanic rock with high MgO content. Olivine-rich basaltic composition.
rocks.description: 高镁橄榄玄武岩，橄榄石丰富。

rocks.name: 科马提岩
rocks.description_en: Ultramafic volcanic rock with very high MgO (>18%). Ancient komatiite flows, rare in modern Earth.
rocks.description: 超基性火山岩，MgO含量高。古代科马提岩流。

rocks.name: 玻基橄辉岩
rocks.description_en: Olivine melilitite with glassy matrix. Very rare ultramafic volcanic rock.
rocks.description: 橄榄辉石岩，玻璃质基质。稀有超基性火山岩。

rocks.name: 辉长岩
rocks.description_en: Coarse-grained mafic intrusive rock composed of plagioclase and pyroxene. The plutonic equivalent of basalt, formed from slow magma cooling at depth.
rocks.description: 粗粒基性侵入岩，是玄武岩的深成对应岩石。主要由斜长石和辉石组成。

rocks.name: 辉长玢岩
rocks.description_en: Porphyritic gabbro with large plagioclase and pyroxene crystals in finer groundmass.
rocks.description: 斑状辉长岩，斜长石和辉石斑晶。

rocks.name: 闪长岩
rocks.description_en: Coarse-grained intermediate intrusive rock composed mainly of plagioclase and hornblende. Contains little or no quartz, dark-colored.
rocks.description: 中性侵入岩，主要由斜长石和角闪石组成。颜色较深，含少量或不含石英。

rocks.name: 花岗闪长岩
rocks.description_en: Coarse-grained intrusive rock intermediate between granite and diorite. Contains quartz, plagioclase, and alkali feldspar with biotite and hornblende.
rocks.description: 花岗岩和闪长岩之间的过渡类型侵入岩。含石英、斜长石和碱性长石，以及黑云母和角闪石。

rocks.name: 花岗岩
rocks.description_en: Coarse-grained intrusive igneous rock composed mainly of quartz, alkali feldspar, and plagioclase. Formed from slow cooling of magma beneath Earth's surface.
rocks.description: 粗粒侵入型火成岩，主要由石英、碱性长石和斜长石组成。颜色通常为浅色（灰白色、肉红色等），是大陆地壳中最常见的岩石之一。

rocks.name: 伟晶岩
rocks.description_en: Very coarse-grained igneous rock with crystals larger than 1 cm. Often contains rare minerals, gemstones, and pegmatitic gemstones.
rocks.description: 极粗粒火成岩，晶体大于1厘米。常含稀有矿物和宝石。

rocks.name: 细晶岩
rocks.description_en: Fine-grained equigranular igneous rock composed mainly of quartz and feldspar. Aplite texture, light-colored.
rocks.description: 细粒等粒火成岩，由石英和长石组成。

rocks.name: 霓细花岗岩
rocks.formula: Alkali feldspar + Quartz, little dark minerals
rocks.description_en: Light-colored granite with alkali feldspar and quartz. Contains little dark-colored minerals.
rocks.description: 浅色花岗岩，碱性长石和石英为主，暗色矿物少。

rocks.name: 霓霞岩
rocks.description_en: Nepheline-bearing ultramafic volcanic rock. Rare alkaline extrusive rock type.
rocks.description: 含霞石的超基性喷出岩。霓霞岩组成。

rocks.name: 霞石岩
rocks.description_en: Foid-bearing volcanic rock with nepheline >35%. Very rare alkaline volcanic rock.
rocks.description: 似长石含量大于35%的喷出岩。稀有碱性喷出岩。

rocks.name: 响岩
rocks.description_en: Light-colored alkali volcanic rock containing feldspathoids (nepheline or leucite). Phonolitic texture with resonant sound when struck.
rocks.description: 碱性喷出岩，含似长石。音响结构。

rocks.name: 玄武岩
rocks.description_en: Fine-grained, dark-colored mafic extrusive volcanic rock composed primarily of plagioclase and pyroxene. The most abundant rock in Earth's oceanic crust.
rocks.description: 细粒基性喷出岩，主要由斜长石和辉石组成。颜色深暗（灰黑色、黑绿色），是地球上大洋中脊最主要的岩石。

rocks.name: 碱性玄武岩
rocks.description_en: Alkali basalt with high alkali content (Na2O + K2O > 3%). Typically found in ocean islands and continental rift zones.
rocks.description: 高碱玄武岩，Na2O+K2O含量高。常见于大洋岛屿和大陆裂谷。

rocks.name: 安山岩
rocks.description_en: Intermediate extrusive volcanic rock, typically gray to dark gray. Composed mainly of plagioclase with hornblende or biotite. Common in volcanic arcs above subduction zones.
rocks.description: 中性喷出岩，呈灰色至深灰色。主要由斜长石和角闪石或黑云母组成。常见于火山弧地区。

rocks.name: 粗面安山岩
rocks.description_en: Intermediate volcanic rock between andesite and trachyte. Contains both plagioclase and alkali feldspar.
rocks.description: 安山岩和粗面岩之间的过渡类型。

rocks.name: 流纹岩
rocks.description_en: Light-colored felsic extrusive volcanic rock, the volcanic equivalent of granite. Composed of quartz and alkali feldspar with fine-grained to glassy texture.
rocks.description: 酸性喷出岩，是花岗岩的火山对应岩石。颜色浅，主要由石英和碱性长石组成，常具流纹构造。

rocks.name: 粗面岩
rocks.description_en: Light-colored volcanic rock dominated by alkali feldspar. Trachytic texture with aligned feldspar crystals.
rocks.description: 浅色碱性喷出岩，碱性长石为主。具粗面结构。

rocks.name: 黑曜岩
rocks.description_en: Volcanic glass with completely glassy texture. Black or dark green color with conchoidal fracture. Forms from rapid lava cooling.
rocks.description: 火山玻璃，完全玻璃质，无晶质。呈黑色或深绿色，贝壳状断口。

rocks.name: 浮岩
rocks.description_en: Light-colored, extremely porous volcanic glass. Formed from frothy lava with rapid gas escape during eruption.
rocks.description: 多孔火山玻璃，比重极小，可浮于水面。火山泡沫急剧冷却形成。

rocks.name: 珍珠岩
rocks.description_en: Hydrated volcanic glass with concentric crack patterns (perlitic structure). Expands when heated rapidly.
rocks.description: 含水火山玻璃，球状裂纹。加热时膨胀形成膨胀珍珠岩。

rocks.name: 松脂岩
rocks.description_en: Volcanic glass with resinous or waxy luster. Contains 5-10% water, duller than obsidian.
rocks.description: 树脂光泽火山玻璃，含水5-10%。

rocks.name: 火山角砾岩
rocks.description_en: Volcanic breccia with angular fragments larger than 64mm in volcanic matrix. Pyroclastic origin with coarse fragments.
rocks.description: 火山碎屑岩，角砾状碎屑大于64毫米。

rocks.name: 熔结凝灰岩
rocks.description_en: Welded tuff formed by hot volcanic ash that fused together during deposition. Features flattened pumice fragments (fiamme).
rocks.description: 火山碎屑岩，炽热火山灰熔接形成。

rocks.name: 晶屑凝灰岩
rocks.description_en: Tuff composed mainly of crystal fragments (quartz, feldspar) and volcanic glass. Common in explosive volcanic regions.
rocks.description: 火山碎屑岩，主要由晶屑（石英、长石）组成。

rocks.name: 砾岩
rocks.description_en: Coarse-grained sedimentary rock with rounded clasts larger than 2mm in finer matrix. Conglomerate type.
rocks.description: 粗粒沉积岩，圆形砾石大于2毫米。

rocks.name: 角砾岩
rocks.description_en: Coarse-grained sedimentary rock with angular clasts. Formed by mechanical fragmentation near source area.
rocks.description: 粗粒沉积岩，角状砾石大于2毫米。近源碎屑沉积的标志。

rocks.name: 冰碛岩
rocks.description_en: Glacial deposit (tillite) with unsorted mix of boulders, gravel, sand, and clay. Evidence of ancient glaciation.
rocks.description: 冰川沉积形成的砾岩。未分选。

rocks.name: 石英砂岩
rocks.description_en: Sandstone composed almost entirely of quartz grains (>90%). Well-sorted, mature sedimentary rock.
rocks.description: 砂岩，几乎全部由石英颗粒组成。成熟度高的沉积岩。

rocks.name: 长石砂岩
rocks.description_en: Sandstone with significant feldspar content (>25%). Arkose type, indicates rapid erosion of granitic source terrain.
rocks.description: 砂岩，长石含量大于25%。快速侵蚀花岗岩来源的标志。

rocks.name: 海绿石砂岩
rocks.description_en: Sandstone containing glauconite green grains. Forms in marine shelf environments.
rocks.description: 含海绿石的砂岩。绿色海绿石颗粒。

rocks.name: 风成砂岩
rocks.description_en: Sandstone deposited by wind. Characterized by large-scale cross-bedding and well-sorted grains.
rocks.description: 风成沉积形成的砂岩。大型交错层理。

rocks.name: 页岩
rocks.description_en: Fine-grained sedimentary rock composed of clay and silt-sized particles. Characterized by lamination and fissility.
rocks.description: 细粒沉积岩，由粘土和粉砂级颗粒组成。具层理和页理。

rocks.name: 钙质页岩
rocks.description_en: Shale containing 10-50% calcium carbonate. Calcareous shale type.
rocks.description: 含碳酸钙的页岩。钙质10-50%。

rocks.name: 油页岩
rocks.description_en: Organic-rich shale containing kerogen. Can be processed to extract shale oil.
rocks.description: 含油页岩，富含油母质。可提取页岩油。

rocks.name: 石灰岩
rocks.description_en: Sedimentary rock composed primarily of calcite (CaCO3). Formed by accumulation of shell fragments, coral, or chemical precipitation.
rocks.description: 沉积岩，主要由碳酸钙（方解石）组成。形成于海洋生物残骸堆积或化学沉淀。

rocks.name: 鲕粒灰岩
rocks.description_en: Limestone composed of ooids (sand-sized coated grains). Ooids form by accretion of calcite around nucleus.
rocks.description: 石灰岩，由鲕粒（砂粒大小的包壳颗粒）组成。

rocks.name: 白云岩
rocks.description_en: Dolomitic sedimentary rock composed mainly of dolomite (CaMg(CO3)2). Forms by alteration of limestone.
rocks.description: 白云石沉积岩，主要成分为白云石(白云石CaMg(CO3)2)。由石灰岩蚀变形成。

rocks.name: 礁灰岩
rocks.description_en: Limestone built by coral reef framework. Forms from reef-building organisms in warm shallow seas.
rocks.description: 石灰岩，由珊瑚礁格架组成。珊瑚礁建造。

rocks.name: 叠层石灰岩
rocks.description_en: Limestone formed by cyanobacterial mats. Stromatolite structures show layered microbial growth.
rocks.description: 石灰岩，由蓝藻垫层形成。叠层石构造。

rocks.name: 竹叶状灰岩
rocks.description_en: Limestone with oncoid pebbles (algal-coated grains). Wackestone to packstone texture.
rocks.description: 竹叶状石灰岩，叠瓦状砾屑。

rocks.name: 豹皮灰岩
rocks.description_en: Limestone with dolomitic spots or mottling. Spotted limestone pattern.
rocks.description: 斑点石灰岩，白云石斑点。

rocks.name: 鸟眼灰岩
rocks.description_en: Limestone with bird's eye voids (mud cracks). Limestone with fenestral porosity.
rocks.description: 鸟眼石灰岩，泥裂和孔洞。

rocks.name: 风暴岩
rocks.description_en: Limestone deposited by storm activity. Features hummocky cross-bedding and storm layers.
rocks.description: 风暴沉积形成的石灰岩。风暴递变层理。

rocks.name: 白垩
rocks.description_en: Soft, porous limestone composed of microscopic marine plankton shells (coccolithophores). Chalk deposits.
rocks.description: 柔软多孔石灰岩，由微体海洋浮游生物（颗石藻）壳体组成。

rocks.name: 燧石岩
rocks.description_en: Hard, fine-grained sedimentary rock composed of microcrystalline quartz (chert). Often occurs in nodules or layers.
rocks.description: 硅质沉积岩，由微晶石英（燧石）组成。常呈结核或夹层产出。

rocks.name: 石英岩
rocks.description_en: Metamorphic rock formed from quartz sandstone. Hard, tough, composed of interlocking quartz grains.
rocks.description: 变质岩，由石英砂岩变质形成。坚硬、坚韧，由结合在一起的石英颗粒组成。

rocks.name: 放射虫硅质岩
rocks.description_en: Siliceous sedimentary rock composed of radiolarian fossils. Forms in deep marine environments.
rocks.description: 放射虫硅质沉积岩。放射虫化石。

rocks.name: 硅藻土
rocks.description_en: Light-colored, porous sedimentary rock composed of diatom frustules. Forms in freshwater and marine environments.
rocks.description: 硅质沉积岩，由硅藻壳体组成。硅藻化石。

rocks.name: 石膏岩
rocks.description_en: Evaporite rock composed of gypsum (CaSO4·2H2O). Forms by precipitation from evaporating seawater.
rocks.description: 蒸发岩，主要成分为石膏(石膏CaSO4·2H2O)。海水分馏蒸发形成。

rocks.name: 硬石膏岩
rocks.description_en: Evaporite rock composed of anhydrite (CaSO4). Forms in deep burial evaporite sequences.
rocks.description: 蒸发岩，主要成分为硬石膏(无水石膏CaSO4)。深埋蒸发岩序列中产出。

rocks.name: 岩盐
rocks.description_en: Evaporite rock composed of halite (NaCl). Forms by precipitation from evaporating seawater.
rocks.description: 蒸发岩，主要成分为氯化钠。海水分馏蒸发形成。

rocks.name: 钾盐岩
rocks.description_en: Evaporite rock composed of sylvite (KCl). Important source of potassium for fertilizers.
rocks.description: 蒸发岩，主要成分为氯化钾。钾肥来源。

rocks.name: 锰结核
rocks.description_en: Manganese nodules on deep ocean floor. Contains manganese, iron, and other metals.
rocks.description: 锰铁氧化物结核。深海多金属结核。

rocks.name: 磷块岩
rocks.description_en: Sedimentary rock with phosphate content >50%. Important source of phosphorus for fertilizers.
rocks.description: 磷酸盐含量大于50%的沉积岩。磷矿石。

rocks.name: 铝土矿
rocks.description_en: Aluminum ore rock composed of aluminum hydroxides (gibbsite, boehmite). Primary source of aluminum.
rocks.description: 铝氢氧化物沉积岩。铝矿石。

rocks.name: 油页岩
rocks.description_en: Organic-rich shale containing kerogen. Can be processed to extract shale oil.
rocks.description: 含油页岩，富含油母质。可提取页岩油。

rocks.name: 煤矸石
rocks.description_en: Carbonaceous shale associated with coal seams. Mining waste product.
rocks.description: 煤中页岩夹石。煤层伴生岩石。

rocks.name: 板岩
rocks.description_en: Fine-grained, low-grade metamorphic rock with slaty cleavage. Lowest grade metamorphic rock from shale.
rocks.description: 细粒低级变质岩，板岩劈裂。最低级别的变质岩。

rocks.name: 千枚岩
rocks.description_en: Fine-grained phyllosilicate rock with silky sheen. Low-grade metamorphic equivalent of shale.
rocks.description: 细粒绢云母片岩，丝绢光泽。低级变质岩的产物。

rocks.name: 硬绿泥石板岩
rocks.description_en: Slate containing chloritoid minerals. Low-grade metamorphic rock.
rocks.description: 含硬绿泥石的板岩。低级变质岩。

rocks.name: 片岩
rocks.description_en: Foliated metamorphic rock with visible platy or elongate minerals (mica, chlorite). Schistose texture developed.
rocks.description: 片状变质岩，可见片状或拉长的云母等矿物。片理发育。

rocks.name: 绿片岩
rocks.description_en: Low-grade metamorphic rock dominated by chlorite and epidote. Greenschist facies metamorphism.
rocks.description: 低级变质岩，以绿泥石和绿帘石为主。绿片岩相。

rocks.name: 片麻岩
rocks.description_en: Banded metamorphic rock with alternating light and dark layers. High-grade regional metamorphism product.
rocks.description: 条带状变质岩，浅色和暗色条带交替。高等级区域变质作用形成。

rocks.name: 云母石英片岩
rocks.description_en: Schist dominated by mica and quartz. Well-developed schistosity from regional metamorphism.
rocks.description: 以云母和石英为主的片岩。片理发育的区域变质产物。

rocks.name: 蓝片岩
rocks.description_en: High-pressure, low-temperature metamorphic rock with glaucophane. Blueschist facies.
rocks.description: 高压低温变质岩，含蓝闪石。蓝片岩相。

rocks.name: 榴辉岩
rocks.description_en: Ultra-high pressure metamorphic rock composed of omphacite and garnet. Eclogite facies.
rocks.description: 超高压力变质岩，由绿辉石和石榴石组成榴辉岩相。

rocks.name: 麻粒岩
rocks.description_en: High-grade metamorphic rock without hydrous minerals. Granulite facies, anhydrous mineral assemblage.
rocks.description: 高级变质岩，无水矿物。麻粒岩相。

rocks.name: 角闪岩
rocks.description_en: Medium to high-grade metamorphic rock dominated by hornblende and plagioclase. Amphibolite facies.
rocks.description: 中高级变质岩，以角闪石和斜长石为主。角闪岩相。

rocks.name: 蓝晶石片岩
rocks.description_en: Schist containing kyanite crystals. High-pressure metamorphic mineral assemblage.
rocks.description: 含蓝晶石的片岩。高压变质矿物组合。

rocks.name: 硅线石片麻岩
rocks.description_en: Gneiss containing sillimanite crystals. High-grade metamorphic mineral.
rocks.description: 含硅线石的片麻岩。高压变质矿物。

rocks.name: 十字石片岩
rocks.description_en: Schist containing staurolite crystals. Medium-grade metamorphic mineral.
rocks.description: 含十字石的片岩。中级变质矿物。

rocks.name: 角岩
rocks.description_en: Fine-grained, non-foliated contact metamorphic rock. Forms in thermal aureole around intrusions.
rocks.description: 细粒非片状接触变质岩。在侵入体热晕中形成。

rocks.name: 大理岩
rocks.description_en: Metamorphic rock formed by recrystallization of limestone or dolomite. Composed of interlocking calcite or dolomite crystals.
rocks.description: 变质岩，由石灰岩或白云岩重结晶形成。由互相结合的方解石或白云石晶体组成。

rocks.name: 石英岩
rocks.description_en: Metamorphic rock formed from quartz sandstone. Hard, tough, composed of interlocking quartz grains.
rocks.description: 变质岩，由石英砂岩变质形成。坚硬、坚韧，由结合在一起的石英颗粒组成。

rocks.name: 矽卡岩
rocks.description_en: Calcium-rich metamorphic rock formed by contact metasomatism. Associated with ore deposits.
rocks.description: 钙质接触交代变质岩。与成矿作用密切相关。

rocks.name: 透闪石大理岩
rocks.description_en: Marble containing tremolite crystals. Contact metamorphic rock in calcareous strata.
rocks.description: 含透闪石晶体的大理岩。接触变质岩。

rocks.name: 透辉石大理岩
rocks.description_en: Marble containing diopside crystals. High-temperature contact metamorphic rock.
rocks.description: 含透辉石晶体的大理岩。高温接触变质岩。

rocks.name: 符山石矽卡岩
rocks.description_en: Skarn containing vesuvianite crystals. Contact metamorphic rock with garnet and pyroxene.
rocks.description: 含符山石的矽卡岩。接触变质岩。

rocks.name: 糜棱岩
rocks.description_en: Fine-grained, foliated rock formed by dynamic metamorphism in fault zones. Mylonitic texture with porphyroclasts.
rocks.description: 细粒片状动力变质岩。在断层带中由动态变质作用形成。

rocks.name: 碎裂岩
rocks.description_en: Cohesive fault rock with angular fragments. Formed by brecciation in fault zones.
rocks.description: 粘结断层岩，角状碎块。在断层带中由碎裂作用形成。

rocks.name: 超糜棱岩
rocks.description_en: Extremely fine-grained mylonite. Complete recrystallization in fault zones.
rocks.description: 极细粒糜棱岩。重结晶作用。

rocks.name: 蛇纹岩
rocks.description_en: Metamorphic rock composed of serpentine minerals. Formed by hydration of ultramafic rocks.
rocks.description: 变质岩，由蛇纹石矿物组成。由超基性岩水化形成。

rocks.name: 混合岩
rocks.description_en: Banded rock formed by partial melting (migmatite). Alternating leucosome and melanosome bands.
rocks.description: 条带状岩石，由部分熔融形成。浅色体和暗色体交替。

rocks.name: 滑石片岩
rocks.description_en: Schist dominated by talc. Low-grade metamorphic rock, very soft.
rocks.description: 以滑石为主的片岩。低级变质岩。

rocks.name: 石墨片岩
rocks.description_en: Schist containing graphite flakes. Metamorphosed organic carbonaceous material.
rocks.description: 含石墨的片岩。碳质变质岩。

rocks.name: 石英岩
rocks.description_en: Metamorphic rock formed from quartz sandstone. Hard, tough, composed of interlocking quartz grains.
rocks.description: 变质岩，由石英砂岩变质形成。坚硬、坚韧，由结合在一起的石英颗粒组成。

rocks.name: 大理岩
rocks.description_en: Metamorphic rock formed by recrystallization of limestone or dolomite. Composed of interlocking calcite or dolomite crystals.
rocks.description: 变质岩，由石灰岩或白云岩重结晶形成。由互相结合的方解石或白云石晶体组成。

rocks.name: 角岩
rocks.description_en: Fine-grained, non-foliated contact metamorphic rock. Forms in thermal aureole around intrusions.
rocks.description: 细粒非片状接触变质岩。在侵入体热晕中形成。

rocks.name: 钠长片岩
rocks.description_en: Schist containing albite feldspar. Low-grade metamorphic rock.
rocks.description: 含钠长石的片岩。低级变质岩。

rocks.name: 眼球状混合岩
rocks.description_en: Augen gneiss with large potassium feldspar augen. Mylonitic texture with porphyroclasts.
rocks.description: 眼球状混合岩，钾长石眼球。
